title: School Children and Minor Children in a Disability Compensation Dependency Release
content:
**Clause.** The child additions in a Disability Compensation dependency release are one school-child addition for each school child plus one child addition for each minor child when the claims record a school child, nothing when they record no child, and one child addition for each child recorded on them otherwise.

**Who is counted.** Minor children are the child additions recorded on the award's most recent dependency claim. School children are the school-child additions recorded on that claim together with those recorded on a school-attendance claim received the same day.

**Rates.** The additions are at the award's own tier; for a month priced from the 100 percent tier, the child addition is 146.10 and the school-child addition 472.95.

**Truth table**

| School child recorded | Minor child recorded | Child additions each month |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | One school-child addition per school child plus one child addition per minor child |
| Yes | No | One school-child addition per school child |
| No | Yes | One child addition per minor child |
| No | No | Nothing |

**Worked case (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (60% Combined Rating), months at the award's own tier).** The dependency claim records one minor child, and a school-attendance claim received the same day records one school child: 283.77 plus 87.66, that is 371.43 a month.
